article.headline: Scores from last Night: Oak Grove sweeps Biloxi; West Jones girls post two shutouts
article.html:
Oak Grove’s soccer teams swept Biloxi on Saturday, October 31, with the boys winning 4–1 and the girls holding on for a 3–2 victory. The boys scored twice in each half; the girls settled their match’s scoring before halftime and protected the lead through a scoreless second half.

West Jones’s girls added a pair of shutouts, while Alcorn Central’s boys recorded two victories in the reported preseason basketball scores. The basketball figures below are preseason results ahead of MHSAA’s November 3 first-game date.

Soccer: Oak Grove wins both against Biloxi

Oak Grove’s boys built their advantage with two first-half goals while keeping Biloxi off the board. Each team scored after the break, with the Warriors adding two more and Biloxi one. The 4–1 home win gave Oak Grove separation on both sides of halftime.

The girls’ match was tighter. Oak Grove scored three and Biloxi two before the break, then neither side scored again. The Warriors improved to 2–0; Biloxi fell to 1–2. Oak Grove’s second-half clean sheet preserved a 3–2 win.

West Jones girls finish with two shutouts

West Jones defeated Forrest County Agricultural 5–0 and Picayune 6–0 in matches reported as neutral-site contests. The Mustangs scored twice before halftime in each, then added three against the Aggies and four against Picayune after the break. West Jones finished the day 3–0.

Madison Central takes girls win; DeSoto Central boys draw

Madison Central’s girls won 5–0 at DeSoto Central in Southaven. The visitors scored two before halftime and three afterward, keeping DeSoto Central scoreless throughout.

The boys finished 1–1. Madison Central scored in the first half, but DeSoto Central supplied the second-half goal to recover a draw. DeSoto Central’s early schedule also included a 3–2 loss to Oxford on October 26, covered in our earlier soccer recap.

Moss Point sweeps; Grenada boys win

Moss Point won both matches at Philadelphia, with the boys edging the Tornadoes 2–1 and the girls recording a 3–0 shutout. The boys improved to 2–0. Grenada’s boys also won, defeating visiting Cleveland Central 3–1.

Preseason basketball: Alcorn Central wins twice

Alcorn Central’s boys beat Falkner 29–6 and Tishomingo County 27–25 in the reported Saturday scores at Glen. The Tishomingo County result was the closer of the two.

Walnut and New Albany girls collect pairs of wins

Walnut’s girls defeated Saltillo 27–18 and Itawamba Agricultural 42–28.

New Albany’s girls beat Potts Camp 28–15 and edged Holly Springs 29–28.

Raymond’s boys defeated Brandon 48–35 in another reported Saturday preseason result.
